mechanism: Dronedarone inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing cetirizine levels; cetirizine may prolong QT interval additively with dronedarone's cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased cetirizine side effects (drowsiness, anticholinergic effects) and cardiac arrhythmias; consider alternative antihistamine if QT prolongation concerns arise.
